visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan and white corgi with a fluffy, docked tail is seen from a low angle, walking away across a lush green grassy field. In the background, several large, leafy deciduous trees stand under a bright, hazy sky, casting soft shadows on the ground. (2) As the corgi continues its trot, a medium-sized, dark brown dog sitting on its haunches comes into view in the middle distance. The background reveals a row of parked cars and a road separated by yellow caution tape stretched between the tree trunks. (3) The camera follows the corgi's movement, panning slightly to the right. The brown dog remains seated, turning its head to watch the corgi pass by. A black dog and another lighter-colored dog are visible wandering in the far background near the trees. (4) The corgi moves further away toward the tree line. The brown dog finally gets up and starts walking slowly to the right, following the other dogs. The lighting is consistent and natural, with no harsh glares or deep shadows on the grass.

The dynamic range remains narrow, with no sudden shifts in volume or production effects.
